title: An Ember in the Ashes
author: Sabaa Tahir
summary: In a Roman-inspired empire, Laia goes undercover as a slave at an elite military academy to save her brother. Elias, its top cadet, wants nothing more than to desert. Their stories collide.
readIf: you like a brutal, high-stakes YA fantasy with two alternating narrators and a brooding mood.
skipIf: you are sensitive to violence against women and cruelty in an institution.

pairings.reason: Another story that makes children and young people fight in a brutal system.
A far darker, more adult story set in a military academy.
A somewhat lighter YA rebellion story with more romance.
